preconditions.description: Number of nodes and edges are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints are within the range of node indices.

postconditions.description: The output sequence contains exactly n nodes.

postconditions.expression: all(node in output_sequence for node in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: The output sequence includes every node from 1 to n exactly once.
The output sequence is the lexicographically smallest permutation of nodes that can be obtained by traversing the graph starting from node 1.
